```ts
import { keyFingerprint } from "./backup-supervisor.js";
import { mountManagementApi } from "./management-api.js";
import { ALL_MODULES } from "./modules.js";
import { mountStreamApi, type StreamApiDeps } from "./stream-api.js";
import { StreamHost } from "./stream-host.js";

// The route calls `putCredential` itself, so the harness sees the credential write through this
// pass-through wrapper.
const credentialWrites = vi.hoisted(() => ({ onPut: (): void => {} }));
vi.mock("@waitron/credentials", async (importOriginal) => {
  const real = await importOriginal<typeof import("@waitron/credentials")>();
  return {
    ...real,
    putCredential: (...args: Parameters<typeof real.putCredential>) => {
      credentialWrites.onPut();
      return real.putCredential(...args);
    },
  };
});

const RING: KeyRing = loadKeyRing({
  WAITRON_CREDENTIALS_KEY: Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64"),
  WAITRON_CREDENTIALS_KEY_VERSION: "1",
});
const suite = useVenueDb({
  migrations: migrationOptionsFor(manifestSets(), null),
  resetPerTest: false,
  timeoutMs: 60_000,
});

const LOCALE = "es-ES";
const PASSWORD = "correct horse";
const MANAGER_EMAIL = "manager@x.com";
const VENUE_ID = "c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002";
const BODY = {
  endpoint: "https://s3.example.net",
  region: "eu-west-1",
  bucket: "venue-copy",
  prefix: "",
  accessKeyId: "AKIAEXAMPLE",
  secretAccessKey: "not-a-real-secret-0123456789",
};
const BUCKET: BucketConfig = {
  endpoint: "https://s3.example.net",
  region: "eu-west-1",
  bucket: "venue-copy",
  prefix: "",
  accessKeyId: "AKIAEXAMPLE",
  secretAccessKey: "not-a-real-secret-0123456789",
};
const STREAMING: StreamStatus = {
  state: "streaming",
  generation: "gen-0-n-20260923T101500Z",
  reason: null,
  stateSince: "2026-09-23T10:15:30.000Z",
  bucketProblem: null,
  lagMs: 0,
  lastConfirmedUploadAt: "2026-09-23T10:16:00.000Z",
};

// setupTenant(), nextNif() and login(app) — copied from backup-api.route.test.ts:117-180.

let nodeId: string;
let publicKey: string;

beforeAll(async () => {
  await setupTenant();
  const [node] = await suite.db.select({ id: nodes.id }).from(nodes).limit(1);
  nodeId = node!.id;
  publicKey = generateNodeKeyPair().publicKey;
  await setNodePublicKey(suite.db, nodeId, publicKey);
}, 180_000);

interface Harness {
  app: Hono;
  deps: StreamApiDeps;
  key: { value: string | undefined };
  order: string[];
}

function harness(overrides: Partial<StreamApiDeps> = {}, startKey?: string): Harness {
  const key = { value: startKey };
  const order: string[] = [];
  credentialWrites.onPut = () => order.push("put-credential");
  const stream = {
    reload: vi.fn(async () => {
      order.push("reload");
    }),
    status: () => STREAMING,
  } as unknown as StreamHost;
  const deps: StreamApiDeps = {
    db: suite.db,
    ring: RING,
    stream,
    nodeId,
    venueId: VENUE_ID,
    isPrimary: () => true,
    readRecoveryKey: async () => key.value,
    writeRecoveryKey: vi.fn(async (k: string) => {
      order.push("write-key");
      key.value = k;
    }),
    sealedState: {
      refresh: vi.fn(async () => {
        order.push("refresh");
        return "sealed" as const;
      }),
    },
    probe: vi.fn(async () => ({ ok: true as const })),
    ...overrides,
  };
  const app = new Hono();
  mountManagementApi(
    app,
    { db: suite.db, cfg: { nodeId }, secureCookies: false, rpId: "localhost", origin: "http://localhost" },
    () => {},
  );
  mountStreamApi(app, deps, () => {});
  return { app, deps, key, order };
}

async function clearBucket(): Promise<void> {
  await suite.db.execute(sql`delete from tenant_credentials where purpose = 'backup.stream'`);
}

const json = (cookie: string, body: unknown) => ({
  headers: { cookie, "content-type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify(body),
});

describe("stream settings routes", () => {
  it("refuses every route without a manager session", async () => {
    const { app } = harness();
    for (const [method, path] of [
      ["GET", "/api/backup/stream"],
      ["PUT", "/api/backup/stream"],
      ["POST", "/api/backup/stream/test"],
      ["DELETE", "/api/backup/stream"],
      ["GET", "/api/backup/stream/kit"],
    ] as const) {
      const res = await app.request(path, { method });
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "management_session.required" } });
    }
  });

  it("Test probes the bucket it was given and reports a pass", async () => {
    const { app, deps } = harness();
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/test", { method: "POST", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(deps.probe).toHaveBeenCalledWith(BUCKET);
  });

  it("Test treats a blank endpoint as an Amazon bucket", async () => {
    const { app, deps } = harness();
    const cookie = await login(app);
    await app.request("/api/backup/stream/test", {
      method: "POST",
      ...json(cookie, { ...BODY, endpoint: "" }),
    });
    const { endpoint: _dropped, ...amazon } = BUCKET;
    expect(deps.probe).toHaveBeenCalledWith(amazon);
  });

  // Reconciliation N13: every reason the bucket check can give reaches the screen by name, where
  // Task 8b words it; a reason this list lacks would reach the owner as a bare tag.
  it.each([
    "access_denied",
    "conditional_write_unsupported",
    "write_failed",
    "read_mismatch",
    "list_failed",
    "create_only_ignored",
    "fresh_version_refused",
    "if_match_ignored",
    "delete_failed",
  ] satisfies ProbeFailure[])("Test refuses a bucket that fails with %s, naming it", async (reason) => {
    const { app } = harness({ probe: vi.fn(async () => ({ ok: false as const, reason, detail: "from the store" })) });
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/test", { method: "POST", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(res.status).toBe(422);
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({
      error: { code: "backup.stream_test_failed", params: { reason } },
    });
  });

  it("Test reports a bucket that gives no answer at all as unreachable, not as refused", async () => {
    const { app } = harness({
      probe: vi.fn(async () => {
        throw new AppError("backup.stream_request_failed", { operation: "put", key: "k", status: null, name: "ECONNREFUSED" });
      }),
    });
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/test", { method: "POST", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(res.status).toBe(502);
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "backup.stream_request_failed" } });
  });

  it("refuses a missing required field by name, before any probe", async () => {
    const { app, deps } = harness();
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/test", {
      method: "POST",
      ...json(cookie, { ...BODY, region: "" }),
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "backup.request_invalid", params: { field: "region" } } });
    expect(deps.probe).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("refuses an endpoint that is not an http(s) address", async () => {
    const { app } = harness();
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/test", {
      method: "POST",
      ...json(cookie, { ...BODY, endpoint: "s3.example.net" }),
    });
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "backup.request_invalid", params: { field: "endpoint" } } });
  });

  it("Save refuses a bucket that fails the probe and stores nothing", async () => {
    await clearBucket();
    const { app, deps } = harness({ probe: vi.fn(async () => ({ ok: false as const, reason: "write_failed" as const, detail: "403" })) });
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(res.status).toBe(422);
    expect(deps.writeRecoveryKey).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(deps.stream.reload).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const stored = await withTransaction(suite.db, (tx) => tryGetCredential(tx, RING, { purpose: "backup.stream" }));
    expect(stored).toBeNull();
  });

  it("Save sets a recovery key when there is none, refreshes the locked row, seals the bucket, then starts streaming", async () => {
    await clearBucket();
    const { app, key, order } = harness();
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    // randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"), as /api/backup/mint-key mints (backup-api.ts).
    expect(key.value).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
    // The row must be locked under the key BEFORE the first generation opens, or a rebuild from
    // that generation finds no row to unlock.
    expect(order).toEqual(["write-key", "refresh", "put-credential", "reload"]);
    const view = await res.json();
    expect(view).toEqual({
      isPrimary: true,
      configured: true,
      bucket: {
        endpoint: "https://s3.example.net",
        region: "eu-west-1",
        bucket: "venue-copy",
        prefix: "",
        accessKeyId: "AKIAEXAMPLE",
      },
      status: STREAMING,
      keyFingerprint: keyFingerprint(key.value!),
    });
    expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain(BODY.secretAccessKey);
    const stored = await withTransaction(suite.db, (tx) => tryGetCredential(tx, RING, { purpose: "backup.stream" }));
    // Stored through Task 6's payload helper, with this node's location id as the venue (N9).
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({
      venueId: VENUE_ID,
      secretAccessKey: BODY.secretAccessKey,
      endpoint: "https://s3.example.net",
      prefix: "-",
    });
  });

  it("Save keeps an existing recovery key", async () => {
    const { app, deps, key } = harness({}, "recovery-key-one-strong");
    const cookie = await login(app);
    await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(deps.writeRecoveryKey).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(key.value).toBe("recovery-key-one-strong");
  });

  it("Save is refused on a node that is not the primary, before any probe", async () => {
    const { app, deps } = harness({ isPrimary: () => false });
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    expect(res.status).toBe(409);
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "backup.not_primary" } });
    expect(deps.probe).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("the kit carries the bucket, the venue, the recovery key and this node's signing key", async () => {
    const { app } = harness({}, "recovery-key-one-strong");
    const cookie = await login(app);
    await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/kit", { headers: { cookie } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = (await res.json()) as { kit: string; keyFingerprint: string };
    expect(parseRecoveryKit(body.kit)).toEqual({
      version: 1,
      venueId: VENUE_ID,
      bucket: BUCKET,
      recoveryKey: "recovery-key-one-strong",
      pointerSignerPublicKey: publicKey,
    });
    expect(body.keyFingerprint).toBe(keyFingerprint("recovery-key-one-strong"));
  });

  it("offers no kit while no bucket is configured", async () => {
    await clearBucket();
    const { app } = harness({}, "recovery-key-one-strong");
    const cookie = await login(app);
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/kit", { headers: { cookie } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(409);
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "backup.stream_not_configured" } });
  });

  it("offers no kit when this node has no signing key, since no rebuild could verify the pointer", async () => {
    const { app } = harness({}, "recovery-key-one-strong");
    const cookie = await login(app);
    await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    await suite.db.update(nodes).set({ publicKey: null }).where(eq(nodes.id, nodeId));
    try {
      const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream/kit", { headers: { cookie } });
      expect(res.status).toBe(409);
      expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "backup.stream_signer_missing" } });
    } finally {
      await setNodePublicKey(suite.db, nodeId, publicKey);
    }
  });

  it("switching off removes the bucket and stops streaming", async () => {
    const { app, deps } = harness({}, "recovery-key-one-strong");
    const cookie = await login(app);
    await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "PUT", ...json(cookie, BODY) });
    const res = await app.request("/api/backup/stream", { method: "DELETE", headers: { cookie } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ configured: false, bucket: null });
    expect(deps.stream.reload).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    const stored = await withTransaction(suite.db, (tx) => tryGetCredential(tx, RING, { purpose: "backup.stream" }));
    expect(stored).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implement the routes**

Create `apps/server/src/stream-api.ts`:

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import type { Context, Hono } from "hono";
import type { ContentfulStatusCode } from "hono/utils/http-status";
import { readMembershipTrustSet, withTransaction, type Database } from "@waitron/db";
import { deleteCredential, putCredential, type KeyRing } from "@waitron/credentials";
import { authorizeManager } from "@waitron/identity";
import { AppError } from "@waitron/shared";
import { createErrorBoundary, readJsonBody, requireManagementSession } from "@waitron/server-kit";
import { encodeRecoveryKit, type BucketConfig, type ProbeResult, type StreamView } from "@waitron/stream";
import { keyFingerprint } from "./backup-supervisor.js";
import type { SealedStateRefresher } from "./sealed-state.js";
import { STREAM_PURPOSE, readStreamSettings, streamSettingsPayload, type StreamHost } from "./stream-host.js";
import type { Logger } from "./logger.js";
import "./errors.js";

export interface StreamApiDeps {
  db: Database;
  ring: KeyRing;
  stream: Pick<StreamHost, "reload" | "status">;
  nodeId: string;
  /** The prefix the venue streams under — the same value the supervisor is given. */
  venueId: string;
  isPrimary: () => boolean;
  readRecoveryKey: () => Promise<string | undefined>;
  writeRecoveryKey: (key: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** Task 2b's refresher, boot's one instance: re-locks the node's state row (slice 2 spec §3.1)
   * under the current key. Never throws. */
  sealedState: Pick<SealedStateRefresher, "refresh">;
  /** Task 5's bucket check on a store for `bucket`; throws when the bucket gives no answer. */
  probe: (bucket: BucketConfig) => Promise<ProbeResult>;
}

/** What `GET /api/backup/stream` answers. Never the secret access key. */
export interface StreamSettingsView {
  isPrimary: boolean;
  configured: boolean;
  bucket: {
    endpoint: string | null;
    region: string;
    bucket: string;
    prefix: string;
    accessKeyId: string;
  } | null;
  status: StreamView;
  keyFingerprint: string | null;
}

const STATUS: Record<string, ContentfulStatusCode> = {
  "management_session.required": 401,
  "management_session.expired": 401,
  "person.suspended": 403,
  "authorization.not_permitted": 403,
  "backup.request_invalid": 400,
  "backup.not_primary": 409,
  "backup.reload_in_progress": 409,
  "backup.stream_test_failed": 422,
  "backup.stream_not_configured": 409,
  "backup.stream_signer_missing": 409,
  "backup.recovery_key_missing": 409,
  // The bucket gave no answer at all (Task 5's `probeBucket` throws the store's error): not a
  // refusal of the owner's settings, so not 422.
  "backup.stream_request_failed": 502,
};

// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
const CONTROL = /[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/;

/** Screens the settings body. Every field is validated here; the client is never the gate. A
 * refusal names the field, never its value — one of them is the secret key. */
async function readBucketBody(c: Context): Promise<BucketConfig> {
  const body = await readJsonBody<Record<string, unknown>>(c);
  const field = (name: string, required: boolean): string => {
    const value = body[name];
    if (value === undefined || value === "") {
      if (required) throw new AppError("backup.request_invalid", { field: name });
      return "";
    }
    if (typeof value !== "string" || CONTROL.test(value) || value.trim() !== value) {
      throw new AppError("backup.request_invalid", { field: name });
    }
    return value;
  };
  const endpoint = field("endpoint", false);
  if (endpoint !== "") {
    let protocol: string;
    try {
      protocol = new URL(endpoint).protocol;
    } catch {
      throw new AppError("backup.request_invalid", { field: "endpoint" });
    }
    if (protocol !== "https:" && protocol !== "http:") {
      throw new AppError("backup.request_invalid", { field: "endpoint" });
    }
  }
  return {
    ...(endpoint === "" ? {} : { endpoint }),
    region: field("region", true),
    bucket: field("bucket", true),
    prefix: field("prefix", false),
    accessKeyId: field("accessKeyId", true),
    secretAccessKey: field("secretAccessKey", true),
  };
}

export function mountStreamApi(app: Hono, deps: StreamApiDeps, log: Logger): void {
  const run = createErrorBoundary(STATUS, "backup.stream_failed");

  const authorize = async (c: Context): Promise<void> => {
    const sessionId = requireManagementSession(c);
    await withTransaction(deps.db, async (tx) => {
      await authorizeManager(tx, { managementSessionId: sessionId, permission: "system.manage" });
    });
  };
  const guardPrimary = (): void => {
    if (!deps.isPrimary()) throw new AppError("backup.not_primary", {});
  };
  const probeOrRefuse = async (bucket: BucketConfig): Promise<void> => {
    const result = await deps.probe(bucket);
    if (!result.ok) throw new AppError("backup.stream_test_failed", { reason: result.reason });
  };
  const view = async (): Promise<StreamSettingsView> => {
    const bucket = (await readStreamSettings(deps.db, deps.ring))?.bucket ?? null;
    const key = await deps.readRecoveryKey();
    return {
      isPrimary: deps.isPrimary(),
      configured: bucket !== null,
      bucket:
        bucket === null
          ? null
          : {
              endpoint: bucket.endpoint ?? null,
              region: bucket.region,
              bucket: bucket.bucket,
              prefix: bucket.prefix,
              accessKeyId: bucket.accessKeyId,
            },
      status: deps.stream.status(),
      keyFingerprint: key === undefined ? null : keyFingerprint(key),
    };
  };

  app.get("/api/backup/stream", (c) =>
    run(c, log, async () => {
      await authorize(c);
      return c.json(await view());
    }),
  );

  // Test: write, read and delete a probe object and prove the conditional write (spec §4.3).
  app.post("/api/backup/stream/test", (c) =>
    run(c, log, async () => {
      await authorize(c);
      const bucket = await readBucketBody(c);
      await probeOrRefuse(bucket);
      return c.json({ ok: true });
    }),
  );

  // Save and switch on. The order is the invariant: a key exists, the locked row is written under
  // it, and only then does a generation open — so the first generation already holds a row a
  // rebuild can unlock. The refresh comes straight after the `backup.env` write, when there is one,
  // and before the credential write that can refuse: the file has changed whatever this answers.
  app.put("/api/backup/stream", (c) =>
    run(c, log, async () => {
      await authorize(c);
      guardPrimary();
      const bucket = await readBucketBody(c);
      await probeOrRefuse(bucket);
      if ((await deps.readRecoveryKey()) === undefined) {
        await deps.writeRecoveryKey(randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"));
      }
      await deps.sealedState.refresh();
      await withTransaction(deps.db, (tx) =>
        putCredential(tx, deps.ring, {
          purpose: STREAM_PURPOSE,
          value: streamSettingsPayload({ venueId: deps.venueId, bucket }),
        }),
      );
      await deps.stream.reload();
      return c.json(await view());
    }),
  );

  // Switch off. What is already in the bucket stays there; the owner deletes it at the provider.
  app.delete("/api/backup/stream", (c) =>
    run(c, log, async () => {
      await authorize(c);
      guardPrimary();
      await withTransaction(deps.db, (tx) => deleteCredential(tx, { purpose: STREAM_PURPOSE }));
      await deps.stream.reload();
      return c.json(await view());
    }),
  );

  // The recovery kit. Authenticated admin only, over TLS; the body is never logged — the
  // boundary logs codes and params, never response bodies, as `GET /api/backup/recovery-key` does.
  app.get("/api/backup/stream/kit", (c) =>
    run(c, log, async () => {
      await authorize(c);
      const settings = await readStreamSettings(deps.db, deps.ring);
      if (settings === null) throw new AppError("backup.stream_not_configured", {});
      const recoveryKey = await deps.readRecoveryKey();
      if (recoveryKey === undefined) throw new AppError("backup.recovery_key_missing", {});
      const pointerSignerPublicKey = (await readMembershipTrustSet(deps.db))[deps.nodeId];
      if (pointerSignerPublicKey === undefined) throw new AppError("backup.stream_signer_missing", {});
      return c.json({
        // The venue id the stream writes under, as stored with the settings (N9).
        kit: encodeRecoveryKit({
          version: 1,
          venueId: settings.venueId,
          bucket: settings.bucket,
          recoveryKey,
          pointerSignerPublicKey,
        }),
        keyFingerprint: keyFingerprint(recoveryKey),
      });
    }),
  );
}
```

`"backup.stream_failed"` is the boundary's LOG TAG for an unexpected crash, as `"backup.failed"` is
in `backup-api.ts:203`; it is never a wire code and needs no registry entry.

```bash
test a bucket (write, read, delete and the two conditional writes), save and
switch streaming on, switch it off, and hand out the recovery kit: one string
holding the bucket details, the venue id, the recovery key and the public key
that signs the bucket's pointer file.

Saving sets a recovery key when the box has none, locks the secrets row under
it, and only then reloads the stream host, so the first copy already holds a
row a rebuild can open, and new settings take effect without a restart. A
bucket that gives no answer to the Test is reported as unreachable (502),
not as a refused setting."
```

```ts
/** `GET /api/backup/stream`'s stream state. LOCAL copy of `@waitron/stream`'s `StreamView`: `{ state:
 * "off" }` when no supervisor runs, else the running supervisor's `StreamStatus`. */
export type StreamStatusView =
  | { state: "off" }
  | {
      state: "off" | "opening" | "streaming" | "paused" | "refused";
      generation: string | null;
      reason: string | null;
      stateSince: string;
      bucketProblem: { reason: string; since: string } | null;
      lagMs: number;
      lastConfirmedUploadAt: string | null;
    };

/** `GET /api/backup/stream` — LOCAL copy of `apps/server/src/stream-api.ts`'s `StreamSettingsView`.
 * Never carries the secret access key. */
export interface StreamSettingsView {
  isPrimary: boolean;
  configured: boolean;
  bucket: {
    endpoint: string | null;
    region: string;
    bucket: string;
    prefix: string;
    accessKeyId: string;
  } | null;
  status: StreamStatusView;
  keyFingerprint: string | null;
}

/** The settings form's body: blank `endpoint` means an Amazon bucket, blank `prefix` the bucket root. */
export interface StreamBucketBody {
  endpoint: string;
  region: string;
  bucket: string;
  prefix: string;
  accessKeyId: string;
  secretAccessKey: string;
}
```

After `rotateBackupKey`:

```ts
  /** `GET /api/backup/stream` — the bucket copy's settings (never the secret) and its live state. */
  getStreamSettings(): Promise<StreamSettingsView> {
    return this.#request<StreamSettingsView>("/api/backup/stream", "GET");
  }

  /** `PUT /api/backup/stream` — test, save and switch on. Rejects `backup.stream_test_failed`
   * with `params.reason` when the bucket fails the same checks Test runs. */
  saveStreamSettings(body: StreamBucketBody): Promise<StreamSettingsView> {
    return this.#request<StreamSettingsView>("/api/backup/stream", "PUT", body);
  }

  /** `POST /api/backup/stream/test` — the conditional-write checks, nothing stored. */
  testStreamBucket(body: StreamBucketBody): Promise<{ ok: true }> {
    return this.#request<{ ok: true }>("/api/backup/stream/test", "POST", body);
  }

  /** `DELETE /api/backup/stream` — switch streaming off; the bucket's contents stay. */
  turnOffStream(): Promise<StreamSettingsView> {
    return this.#request<StreamSettingsView>("/api/backup/stream", "DELETE");
  }

  /** `GET /api/backup/stream/kit` — the recovery kit, as sensitive as the recovery key. */
  getRecoveryKit(): Promise<{ kit: string; keyFingerprint: string }> {
    return this.#request<{ kit: string; keyFingerprint: string }>("/api/backup/stream/kit", "GET");
  }
```

Create `apps/dashboard/src/screens/stream-settings-panel.test.ts`:

```ts
import { page } from "vitest/browser";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { cleanupWidgets, mountWidget } from "../widgets/test-helpers.js";
import { codeMessage } from "../i18n/codes.js";
import { t } from "../i18n/t.js";
import type { DashboardApi, StreamSettingsView } from "../api/client.js";
import type { StreamSettingsPanel } from "./stream-settings-panel.js";
import "./stream-settings-panel.js";

afterEach(cleanupWidgets);

const OFF: StreamSettingsView = {
  isPrimary: true,
  configured: false,
  bucket: null,
  status: { state: "off" },
  keyFingerprint: null,
};
const ON: StreamSettingsView = {
  isPrimary: true,
  configured: true,
  bucket: { endpoint: null, region: "eu-west-1", bucket: "venue-copy", prefix: "", accessKeyId: "AKIAEXAMPLE" },
  status: {
    state: "streaming",
    generation: "gen-0-n-20260923T101500Z",
    reason: null,
    stateSince: "2026-09-23T10:15:30.000Z",
    bucketProblem: null,
    lastConfirmedUploadAt: "2026-09-23T10:16:00.000Z",
    lagMs: 0,
  },
  keyFingerprint: "ab12cd34",
};
// A realistic kit is one long token with no spaces — the width case below depends on that.
const KIT = `WAITRON-RECOVERY-KIT-1:${"eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJ2ZW51ZUlkIjoi".repeat(12)}`;

function stubApi(overrides: Partial<DashboardApi> = {}, settings = OFF): DashboardApi {
  return {
    getStreamSettings: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(settings),
    saveStreamSettings: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(ON),
    testStreamBucket: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true }),
    turnOffStream: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(OFF),
    getRecoveryKit: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ kit: KIT, keyFingerprint: "ab12cd34" }),
    ...overrides,
  } as unknown as DashboardApi;
}

async function flush(el: StreamSettingsPanel): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
    await el.updateComplete;
  }
}

const q = (el: StreamSettingsPanel, sel: string) => el.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLElement>(sel);

function type(el: StreamSettingsPanel, name: string, value: string): void {
  q(el, `wt-input[name=${name}]`)!.dispatchEvent(
    new CustomEvent("wt-change", { detail: { value }, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
  );
}

function fillRequired(el: StreamSettingsPanel): void {
  type(el, "bucket-region", "eu-west-1");
  type(el, "bucket-name", "venue-copy");
  type(el, "bucket-access-key-id", "AKIAEXAMPLE");
  type(el, "bucket-secret-access-key", "not-a-real-secret-0123456789");
}

describe("stream-settings-panel", () => {
  it("offers the bucket form with every field named and the required ones marked", async () => {
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api: stubApi() });
    await flush(el);
    const names = [...el.shadowRoot!.querySelectorAll("wt-input")].map((i) => i.getAttribute("name"));
    expect(names).toEqual([
      "bucket-endpoint",
      "bucket-region",
      "bucket-name",
      "bucket-prefix",
      "bucket-access-key-id",
      "bucket-secret-access-key",
    ]);
    const required = [...el.shadowRoot!.querySelectorAll("wt-input")]
      .filter((i) => (i as HTMLElement & { required: boolean }).required)
      .map((i) => i.getAttribute("name"));
    expect(required).toEqual(["bucket-region", "bucket-name", "bucket-access-key-id", "bucket-secret-access-key"]);
  });

  it("explains every missing field beside it and in one summary, and sends nothing", async () => {
    const api = stubApi();
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    q(el, "[data-test=save]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.saveStreamSettings).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const summary = el.shadowRoot!.querySelector("wt-form-error-summary") as HTMLElement & { errors: string[] };
    expect(summary.errors).toHaveLength(4);
    const region = q(el, "wt-input[name=bucket-region]") as HTMLElement & { error: string };
    expect(region.error).toBe(t("stream.form.required"));
  });

  it("refuses an endpoint that is not a web address, beside the field", async () => {
    const api = stubApi();
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    fillRequired(el);
    type(el, "bucket-endpoint", "s3.example.net");
    q(el, "[data-test=save]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.saveStreamSettings).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const endpoint = q(el, "wt-input[name=bucket-endpoint]") as HTMLElement & { error: string };
    expect(endpoint.error).toBe(t("stream.form.endpoint_invalid"));
  });

  it("Test sends the typed bucket and says it passed", async () => {
    const api = stubApi();
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    fillRequired(el);
    q(el, "[data-test=test]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.testStreamBucket).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      endpoint: "",
      region: "eu-west-1",
      bucket: "venue-copy",
      prefix: "",
      accessKeyId: "AKIAEXAMPLE",
      secretAccessKey: "not-a-real-secret-0123456789",
    });
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=test-passed]")?.textContent?.trim()).toBe(t("stream.form.test_passed"));
  });

  it("a failed Test shows the localised refusal and the probe's reason", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({
      testStreamBucket: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue({
        code: "backup.stream_test_failed",
        params: { reason: "create_only_ignored" },
        status: 422,
      }),
    });
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    fillRequired(el);
    q(el, "[data-test=test]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    const alert = q(el, "[role=alert]")!;
    expect(alert.textContent).toContain(codeMessage("backup.stream_test_failed"));
    // The failed check in words, never its code.
    expect(alert.textContent).toContain(t("stream.probe.create_only_ignored"));
    expect(alert.textContent).not.toContain("create_only_ignored");
  });

  it("Save switches streaming on and immediately offers the kit with its warning, a copy button and a real download", async () => {
    const api = stubApi();
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    fillRequired(el);
    q(el, "[data-test=save]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.saveStreamSettings).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(api.getRecoveryKit).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(KIT);
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit-warning]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(t("stream.kit.warning"));
    const download = q(el, "[data-test=download-kit]") as HTMLAnchorElement;
    expect(download.href.startsWith("blob:")).toBe(true);
    expect(download.getAttribute("download")).toBe("waitron-recovery-kit-ab12cd34.txt");
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=copy-kit]")).not.toBeNull();
    // The secret is not kept once saved: changing the bucket later starts with it blank and the
    // rest of the settings filled in from the server.
    q(el, "[data-test=change]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    const secret = q(el, "wt-input[name=bucket-secret-access-key]") as HTMLElement & { value: string };
    const region = q(el, "wt-input[name=bucket-region]") as HTMLElement & { value: string };
    expect(secret.value).toBe("");
    expect(region.value).toBe("eu-west-1");
  });

  it("shows how current the copy is when streaming is on, and the kit on request", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({}, ON);
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=stream-state]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(t("stream.state.streaming"));
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=stream-lag]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(t("stream.status.lag_none"));
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit]")).toBeNull();
    q(el, "[data-test=show-kit]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(KIT);
  });

  it("reports waiting changes in minutes", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({}, { ...ON, status: { ...ON.status, lagMs: 17 * 60_000 } });
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=stream-lag]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(`17 ${t("stream.status.minutes")}`);
  });

  it("re-issues the kit when the recovery key changes, with the keep-the-old-kit banner", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({}, ON);
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", {
      api,
      keyFingerprint: "ab12cd34",
    });
    await flush(el);
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit-reissued]")).toBeNull();
    el.keyFingerprint = "ffee0011";
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.getRecoveryKit).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit-reissued]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(t("stream.kit.reissued"));
  });

  it("does not re-issue on the first fingerprint it is given", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({}, ON);
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    el.keyFingerprint = "ab12cd34";
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.getRecoveryKit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("offers nothing to change on a server that is not the primary", async () => {
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", {
      api: stubApi({}, { ...OFF, isPrimary: false }),
    });
    await flush(el);
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=not-primary]")!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(t("stream.not_primary"));
    expect(el.shadowRoot!.querySelector("wt-input")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("Turn off stops streaming and hides the kit", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({}, ON);
    const { el } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
    await flush(el);
    q(el, "[data-test=show-kit]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    q(el, "[data-test=turn-off]")!.click();
    await flush(el);
    expect(api.turnOffStream).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(q(el, "[data-test=kit]")).toBeNull();
    expect(el.shadowRoot!.querySelector("wt-input[name=bucket-region]")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("fits a phone's width with the kit shown — the kit is one long token", async () => {
    await page.viewport(390, 844);
    try {
      const api = stubApi({}, ON);
      const { el, host } = await mountWidget<StreamSettingsPanel>("dashboard-stream-settings", { api });
      await flush(el);
      q(el, "[data-test=show-kit]")!.click();
      await flush(el);
      // State the width measured, not the one asked for (testing-guide.md, "A width you set…").
      expect(window.innerWidth).toBe(390);
      expect(el.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(host.clientWidth);
      const kit = q(el, "[data-test=kit]")!;
      expect(kit.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(kit.clientWidth);
    } finally {
      await page.viewport(1280, 900);
    }
  });
});
```

Create `apps/dashboard/src/screens/stream-settings-panel.ts`:

```ts
import { LitElement, type PropertyValues, type TemplateResult, css, html, nothing } from "lit";
import { customElement, property, state } from "lit/decorators.js";
import { baseStyles, submitOnEnter } from "@waitron/ui";
import "@waitron/ui/src/components/wt-button.js";
import "@waitron/ui/src/components/wt-input.js";
import "@waitron/ui/src/components/wt-form-actions.js";
import "@waitron/ui/src/components/wt-form-error-summary.js";
import { DashboardQueries } from "../api/query-controller.js";
import type { StringKey } from "../i18n/strings.js";
import { t } from "../i18n/t.js";
import { codeMessage, codeOf } from "../i18n/codes.js";
import type { DashboardApi, StreamBucketBody, StreamSettingsView } from "../api/client.js";

type Field = keyof StreamBucketBody;

const EMPTY: StreamBucketBody = {
  endpoint: "",
  region: "",
  bucket: "",
  prefix: "",
  accessKeyId: "",
  secretAccessKey: "",
};

/** Each form field: its semantic `name`, its label key, and whether it is required. */
const FIELDS: { field: Field; name: string; labelKey: Parameters<typeof t>[0]; required: boolean }[] = [
  { field: "endpoint", name: "bucket-endpoint", labelKey: "stream.form.endpoint", required: false },
  { field: "region", name: "bucket-region", labelKey: "stream.form.region", required: true },
  { field: "bucket", name: "bucket-name", labelKey: "stream.form.bucket", required: true },
  { field: "prefix", name: "bucket-prefix", labelKey: "stream.form.prefix", required: false },
  { field: "accessKeyId", name: "bucket-access-key-id", labelKey: "stream.form.access_key_id", required: true },
  { field: "secretAccessKey", name: "bucket-secret-access-key", labelKey: "stream.form.secret_access_key", required: true },
];

const STATE_KEYS = {
  off: "stream.state.off",
  opening: "stream.state.opening",
  streaming: "stream.state.streaming",
  paused: "stream.state.paused",
  refused: "stream.state.refused",
} as const;

/** One sentence per bucket-check reason (Task 5's `ProbeFailure`, passed through by 8a). A reason
 * missing here is shown as its code rather than hidden. */
const PROBE_REASON_KEYS: Readonly<Record<string, StringKey>> = {
  access_denied: "stream.probe.access_denied",
  conditional_write_unsupported: "stream.probe.conditional_write_unsupported",
  write_failed: "stream.probe.write_failed",
  read_mismatch: "stream.probe.read_mismatch",
  list_failed: "stream.probe.list_failed",
  create_only_ignored: "stream.probe.create_only_ignored",
  fresh_version_refused: "stream.probe.fresh_version_refused",
  if_match_ignored: "stream.probe.if_match_ignored",
  delete_failed: "stream.probe.delete_failed",
};

/**
 * The bucket copy on the Backups screen (slice 2 spec §4.3): the bucket settings, Test, how
 * current the copy is, and the recovery kit. `keyFingerprint` is the Backups screen's running key
 * fingerprint; when it changes after the first value, the recovery key rotated and the kit is
 * re-issued with a banner (spec §3.1: older copies still need the old kit for seven days).
 */
@customElement("dashboard-stream-settings")
export class StreamSettingsPanel extends LitElement {
  static override styles = [
    baseStyles,
    css`
      :host {
        display: block;
      }
      .card {
        max-width: 34rem;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--wt-space-3);
      }
      h2 {
        margin: var(--wt-space-6) 0 var(--wt-space-2);
        font-size: var(--wt-font-size-md);
        color: var(--wt-color-text);
      }
      .hint {
        color: var(--wt-color-text-muted);
        font-size: var(--wt-font-size-sm);
      }
      .status {
        margin: 0;
        padding: var(--wt-space-3);
        background: var(--wt-color-surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--wt-color-border);
        border-radius: var(--wt-radius-md);
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--wt-space-1);
      }
      .status dt {
        color: var(--wt-color-text-muted);
        font-size: var(--wt-font-size-sm);
      }
      .status dd {
        margin: 0 0 var(--wt-space-2);
        color: var(--wt-color-text);
      }
      .key {
        font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        font-size: var(--wt-font-size-sm);
        word-break: break-all;
        margin: 0;
        padding: var(--wt-space-2) var(--wt-space-3);
        background: var(--wt-color-surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--wt-color-border);
        border-radius: var(--wt-radius-md);
        color: var(--wt-color-text);
      }
      .actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--wt-space-2);
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      a.download {
        color: var(--wt-color-text);
        font-size: var(--wt-font-size-sm);
        text-decoration: underline;
      }
      .warning {
        margin: 0;
        padding: var(--wt-space-3);
        border: 1px solid var(--wt-color-danger);
        border-radius: var(--wt-radius-md);
        color: var(--wt-color-danger);
        background: var(--wt-color-surface);
      }
      .error {
        color: var(--wt-color-danger);
      }
      .passed {
        color: var(--wt-color-text);
      }
    `,
  ];

  @property({ attribute: false }) api!: DashboardApi;
  /** The running recovery key's fingerprint, from the Backups screen's status. */
  @property({ attribute: false }) keyFingerprint?: string;

  readonly #queries = new DashboardQueries(
    this,
    () => this.api,
    (error) => {
      this.errorKey = codeOf(error);
    },
  );

  @state() private settings?: StreamSettingsView;
  @state() private draft: StreamBucketBody = { ...EMPTY };
  @state() private editing = false;
  @state() private errors: Partial<Record<Field, string>> = {};
  @state() private submitting = false;
  @state() private testPassed = false;
  @state() private errorKey: string | null = null;
  @state() private errorReason: string | null = null;
  @state() private kit: string | null = null;
  @state() private kitFingerprint: string | null = null;
  @state() private kitReissued = false;
  @state() private secretVisible = false;

  #blobUrls = new Map<string, string>();

  override connectedCallback(): void {
    super.connectedCallback();
    void this.#load();
  }

  override disconnectedCallback(): void {
    for (const url of this.#blobUrls.values()) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    this.#blobUrls.clear();
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  protected override updated(changed: PropertyValues<this>): void {
    const previous = changed.get("keyFingerprint") as string | undefined;
    if (
      changed.has("keyFingerprint") &&
      previous !== undefined &&
      previous !== this.keyFingerprint &&
      this.settings?.configured === true
    ) {
      this.kitReissued = true;
      void this.#loadKit();
    }
  }

  async #load(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.#queries.watch("getStreamSettings", [], (value) => {
        this.settings = value;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.#fail(error);
    }
  }

  #fail(error: unknown): void {
    this.errorKey = codeOf(error);
    const reason = (error as { params?: { reason?: unknown } }).params?.reason;
    this.errorReason = typeof reason === "string" ? reason : null;
  }

  #clearMessages(): void {
    this.errorKey = null;
    this.errorReason = null;
    this.testPassed = false;
  }

  /** Field errors for the current draft; empty when it may be sent. */
  #validate(): Partial<Record<Field, string>> {
    const errors: Partial<Record<Field, string>> = {};
    for (const f of FIELDS) {
      if (f.required && this.draft[f.field].trim() === "") errors[f.field] = t("stream.form.required");
    }
    const endpoint = this.draft.endpoint.trim();
    if (endpoint !== "" && !/^https?:\/\/\S+$/.test(endpoint)) {
      errors.endpoint = t("stream.form.endpoint_invalid");
    }
    return errors;
  }

  #body(): StreamBucketBody {
    return {
      endpoint: this.draft.endpoint.trim(),
      region: this.draft.region.trim(),
      bucket: this.draft.bucket.trim(),
      prefix: this.draft.prefix.trim(),
      accessKeyId: this.draft.accessKeyId.trim(),
      secretAccessKey: this.draft.secretAccessKey,
    };
  }

  async #test(): Promise<void> {
    this.#clearMessages();
    this.errors = this.#validate();
    if (Object.keys(this.errors).length > 0 || this.submitting) return;
    this.submitting = true;
    try {
      await this.api.testStreamBucket(this.#body());
      this.testPassed = true;
    } catch (error) {
      this.#fail(error);
    } finally {
      this.submitting = false;
    }
  }

  async #save(): Promise<void> {
    this.#clearMessages();
    this.errors = this.#validate();
    if (Object.keys(this.errors).length > 0 || this.submitting) return;
    this.submitting = true;
    try {
      this.settings = await this.api.saveStreamSettings(this.#body());
      this.editing = false;
      this.draft = { ...EMPTY };
      await this.#loadKit();
    } catch (error) {
      this.#fail(error);
    } finally {
      this.submitting = false;
    }
  }

  async #turnOff(): Promise<void> {
    this.#clearMessages();
    try {
      this.settings = await this.api.turnOffStream();
      this.kit = null;
      this.kitReissued = false;
    } catch (error) {
      this.#fail(error);
    }
  }

  async #loadKit(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const { kit, keyFingerprint } = await this.api.getRecoveryKit();
      this.kit = kit;
      this.kitFingerprint = keyFingerprint;
    } catch (error) {
      this.#fail(error);
    }
  }

  #startEdit(): void {
    const b = this.settings?.bucket;
    this.draft = {
      endpoint: b?.endpoint ?? "",
      region: b?.region ?? "",
      bucket: b?.bucket ?? "",
      prefix: b?.prefix ?? "",
      accessKeyId: b?.accessKeyId ?? "",
      secretAccessKey: "",
    };
    this.errors = {};
    this.editing = true;
  }

  #downloadHref(kit: string): string {
    let url = this.#blobUrls.get(kit);
    if (url === undefined) {
      const body = `${t("stream.kit.file_heading")}\n${t("stream.kit.file_note")}\n\n${kit}\n`;
      url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([body], { type: "text/plain" }));
      this.#blobUrls.set(kit, url);
    }
    return url;
  }

  override render(): TemplateResult {
    const s = this.settings;
    return html`
      <section class="card" aria-labelledby="stream-title">
        <h2 id="stream-title">${t("stream.title")}</h2>
        <p class="hint">${t("stream.explanation")}</p>
        ${s === undefined ? nothing : this.#renderBody(s)}
        ${this.errorKey === null
          ? nothing
          : html`<p class="error" role="alert">
              ${codeMessage(this.errorKey)}${this.errorReason === null
                ? nothing
                : html` ${PROBE_REASON_KEYS[this.errorReason] === undefined
                    ? html`<code>${this.errorReason}</code>`
                    : t(PROBE_REASON_KEYS[this.errorReason]!)}`}
            </p>`}
      </section>
    `;
  }

  #renderBody(s: StreamSettingsView): TemplateResult {
    if (!s.isPrimary) {
      return html`<p class="hint" data-test="not-primary">${t("stream.not_primary")}</p>`;
    }
    return html`
      ${s.configured ? this.#renderStatus(s) : nothing}
      ${!s.configured || this.editing
        ? this.#renderForm(s.configured)
        : html`<div class="actions">
            ${this.kit === null
              ? html`<wt-button variant="secondary" data-test="show-kit" @click=${() => void this.#loadKit()}
                  >${t("stream.show_kit")}</wt-button
                >`
              : nothing}
            <wt-button variant="secondary" data-test="change" @click=${() => this.#startEdit()}
              >${t("stream.change")}</wt-button
            >
            <wt-button variant="ghost" data-test="turn-off" @click=${() => void this.#turnOff()}
              >${t("stream.turn_off")}</wt-button
            >
          </div>`}
      ${this.kit === null ? nothing : this.#renderKit(this.kit)}
    `;
  }

  #renderStatus(s: StreamSettingsView): TemplateResult {
    // `{ state: "off" }` carries nothing else: no supervisor runs (Task 7's `StreamView`).
    const lagMs = "lagMs" in s.status ? s.status.lagMs : 0;
    const last = "lastConfirmedUploadAt" in s.status ? s.status.lastConfirmedUploadAt : null;
    const minutes = Math.floor(lagMs / 60_000);
    return html`
      <dl class="status" data-test="stream-status">
        <dt>${t("stream.status.state")}</dt>
        <dd data-test="stream-state">${t(STATE_KEYS[s.status.state])}</dd>
        <dt>${t("stream.status.lag")}</dt>
        <dd data-test="stream-lag">
          ${minutes === 0 ? t("stream.status.lag_none") : `${minutes} ${t("stream.status.minutes")}`}
        </dd>
        <dt>${t("stream.status.last")}</dt>
        <dd data-test="stream-last">
          ${last === null ? t("stream.status.never") : new Date(last).toLocaleString()}
        </dd>
      </dl>
    `;
  }

  #renderForm(canCancel: boolean): TemplateResult {
    const save = () => this.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-test=save]");
    return html`
      <div @keydown=${(event: KeyboardEvent) => submitOnEnter(event, save())}>
        <wt-form-error-summary
          heading=${t("form.error_heading")}
          .errors=${Object.values(this.errors)}
        ></wt-form-error-summary>
        ${FIELDS.map(
          (f) => html`<wt-input
            name=${f.name}
            label=${t(f.labelKey)}
            .required=${f.required}
            type=${f.field === "secretAccessKey" && !this.secretVisible ? "password" : "text"}
            autocomplete="off"
            .value=${this.draft[f.field]}
            .error=${this.errors[f.field] ?? ""}
            @wt-change=${(event: CustomEvent<{ value: string }>) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              this.draft = { ...this.draft, [f.field]: event.detail.value };
            }}
            >${f.field === "secretAccessKey"
              ? html`<wt-button
                  slot="end"
                  variant="ghost"
                  data-test="toggle-secret"
                  aria-label=${this.secretVisible ? t("login.hide_password") : t("login.show_password")}
                  @click=${() => (this.secretVisible = !this.secretVisible)}
                  >${this.secretVisible ? t("login.hide_password") : t("login.show_password")}</wt-button
                >`
              : nothing}</wt-input
          >`,
        )}
        ${this.testPassed
          ? html`<p class="passed" data-test="test-passed" role="status">${t("stream.form.test_passed")}</p>`
          : nothing}
        <wt-form-actions>
          ${canCancel
            ? html`<wt-button slot="cancel" variant="ghost" data-test="cancel" @click=${() => (this.editing = false)}
                >${t("stream.form.cancel")}</wt-button
              >`
            : nothing}
          <wt-button
            slot="secondary"
            variant="secondary"
            data-test="test"
            ?disabled=${this.submitting}
            @click=${() => void this.#test()}
            >${t("stream.form.test")}</wt-button
          >
          <wt-button variant="primary" data-test="save" ?disabled=${this.submitting} @click=${() => void this.#save()}
            >${t("stream.form.save")}</wt-button
          >
        </wt-form-actions>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  #renderKit(kit: string): TemplateResult {
    const fingerprint = this.kitFingerprint ?? "box";
    return html`
      <h2>${t("stream.kit.title")}</h2>
      ${this.kitReissued
        ? html`<p class="warning" role="note" data-test="kit-reissued">${t("stream.kit.reissued")}</p>`
        : nothing}
      <p class="warning" role="note" data-test="kit-warning">${t("stream.kit.warning")}</p>
      <p class="key" data-test="kit">${kit}</p>
      <div class="actions">
        <wt-button
          variant="secondary"
          data-test="copy-kit"
          @click=${() =>
            void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(kit).catch(() => {
              /* clipboard refused — the on-screen kit and the download are the fallback */
            })}
          >${t("stream.kit.copy")}</wt-button
        >
        <a
          class="download"
          data-test="download-kit"
          download=${`waitron-recovery-kit-${fingerprint}.txt`}
          href=${this.#downloadHref(kit)}
          >${t("stream.kit.download")}</a
        >
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    "dashboard-stream-settings": StreamSettingsPanel;
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The archive wizard reuses a held recovery key (Reconciliation O5), failing test first**

Today `#load` mints a new key for any writable box whose archives are off, and `#apply` sends it
(`backup-screen.ts`, `#load` → `#mint`, read), so turning archives on after streaming would replace
the key the recovery kit carries. With Task 2a's server change such an apply is refused
`backup.recovery_key_exists`; this step makes the wizard not try.

In `apps/dashboard/src/screens/backup-screen.test.ts`, add `recoveryKeySet: false,` to `OFF` and
`recoveryKeySet: true,` to `ENABLED` (setup: the type now requires it; `MANAGED` spreads `OFF`), do
the same to the fixtures in `backup-screen.a11y.test.ts`, and add inside `describe("backup-screen")`:

```ts
  it("turning backups on with a recovery key already held mints none and sends none", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({}, { ...OFF, recoveryKeySet: true });
    const { el } = await mountWidget<BackupScreen>("dashboard-backup-screen", { api });
```

**Why this is its own task.** Today the leaf is minted only when `tls/server.key` is absent
(`box-secrets.ts:133`), and a rebuild brings back the dead box's leaf — naming the dead box's IP
addresses — with the certificate authority. Devices trust the authority, not the leaf
(`box-secrets.ts` header comment), so a leaf re-issued by the same authority is accepted.

**Both restore sources (Reconciliation O4).** An archive restored onto new hardware carries the
dead box's leaf in `secrets/tls/server.crt` exactly as a bucket rebuild does
(`apps/server/src/state-secrets.ts:15-22`, read), so the owner decided the archive restore gets the
same first start. This task therefore writes the marker in the one function both sources share,
`writeValidated`, and its tests run the first start for a marker from each source.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

In `apps/server/src/self-signed-cert.ts`, move the leaf half of `mintSelfSignedServerCert` into a
private helper and export the re-issue:

```ts
/** The leaf's extensions and SANs, shared by minting and re-issuing so the two cannot drift. */
function signLeaf(
  caKey: forge.pki.rsa.PrivateKey,
  serverKeys: forge.pki.rsa.KeyPair,
  hostnames: string[],
  ipAddresses: string[],
  validity: { notBefore: Date; notAfter: Date },
): forge.pki.Certificate {
  // type 2 is dNSName, type 7 is iPAddress, so a client can dial either a hostname or an IP.
  const altNames = [
    ...hostnames.map((value) => ({ type: 2, value })),
    ...ipAddresses.map((ip) => ({ type: 7, ip })),
  ];
  return certificate(
    hostnames[0]!,
    serverKeys,
    { cn: CA_COMMON_NAME, key: caKey },
    randomSerial(),
    validity,
    [
      { name: "basicConstraints", cA: false },
      { name: "keyUsage", digitalSignature: true, keyEncipherment: true },
      { name: "extKeyUsage", serverAuth: true },
      { name: "subjectAltName", altNames },
    ],
  );
}

/**
 * A new leaf, with a new key pair, signed by an EXISTING authority — what a box rebuilt on other
 * hardware serves, because the leaf it brought back names the dead box's addresses (slice 2 spec
 * §5.1 step 7). Devices trust the authority, so they accept it without a new trust step. The leaf
 * never outlives its authority.
 */
export function reissueServerLeaf(opts: {
  caCertPem: string;
  caKeyPem: string;
  hostnames: string[];
  ipAddresses: string[];
  now: Date;
  keypair?: () => forge.pki.rsa.KeyPair;
}): { serverCertPem: string; serverKeyPem: string } {
  if (opts.hostnames.length === 0) throw new AppError("setup.cert_hostnames_empty", {});
  const caCert = forge.pki.certificateFromPem(opts.caCertPem);
  const caKey = forge.pki.privateKeyFromPem(opts.caKeyPem) as forge.pki.rsa.PrivateKey;
  const serverKeys = (opts.keypair ?? (() => forge.pki.rsa.generateKeyPair(2048)))();
  const wanted = opts.now.getTime() + VALIDITY_DAYS * DAY_MS;
  const leaf = signLeaf(caKey, serverKeys, opts.hostnames, opts.ipAddresses, {
    notBefore: new Date(opts.now.getTime() - DAY_MS),
    notAfter: new Date(Math.min(wanted, caCert.validity.notAfter.getTime())),
  });
  return {
    serverCertPem: forge.pki.certificateToPem(leaf),
    serverKeyPem: forge.pki.privateKeyToPem(serverKeys.privateKey),
  };
}
```

```ts
 * and the marker the restore left (none for an ordinary start). */
async function rebuiltStateDir(marker: RebuildSource | false): Promise<string> {
  const stateDir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "waitron-rebuild-"));
  await ensureBoxSecrets({
    stateDir,
    hostnames: ["waitron.local", "localhost"],
    now: () => NOW,
    listIpv4: () => [OLD_ADDRESS],
  });
  if (marker !== false) await writeFile(join(stateDir, REBUILD_MARKER), JSON.stringify({ version: 1, source: marker }));
  // The dead box's chart, at term 0, naming its old contact address.
  await seedTermZeroMembership({ db: suite.db, ring: RING }, NODE, "https://old-box.example");
  return stateDir;
}

function deps(stateDir: string, overrides: Partial<RebuildDeps> = {}): RebuildDeps {
  return {
    stateDir,
    db: suite.db,
    ring: RING,
    nodeId: NODE,
    contactUrl: "https://waitron.local",
    hostnames: ["waitron.local", "localhost"],
    listIpv4: () => [NEW_ADDRESS],
    now: () => NOW,
    log: () => {},
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("completeRebuild", () => {
  // Reconciliation O4: a marker left by an archive restore and one left by a bucket rebuild start the
  // same first-start routine.
  it.each(["archive", "stream"] as const)("after a %s restore, presents a certificate naming THIS machine's addresses, from the same authority", async (source) => {
    const stateDir = await rebuiltStateDir(source);
    const caBefore = await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "ca.crt"), "utf8");
    expect(await completeRebuild(deps(stateDir))).toBe(true);
    // The two files the trading listener serves (`mintedBoxLeaf`, box-secrets.ts:43-48).
    const leaf = new X509Certificate(await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "server.crt"), "utf8"));
    expect(leaf.subjectAltName).toContain(`IP Address:${NEW_ADDRESS}`);
    expect(leaf.subjectAltName).not.toContain(OLD_ADDRESS);
    const ca = await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "ca.crt"), "utf8");
    expect(ca).toBe(caBefore);
    expect(leaf.verify(new X509Certificate(ca).publicKey)).toBe(true);
    const key = await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "server.key"), "utf8");
    expect(leaf.checkPrivateKey(createPrivateKey(key))).toBe(true);
    expect((await stat(join(stateDir, "tls", "server.key"))).mode & 0o777).toBe(0o600);
  });

  it.each(["archive", "stream"] as const)("after a %s restore, signs the membership document one term higher, carrying this machine's contact address", async (source) => {
    const stateDir = await rebuiltStateDir(source);
    await completeRebuild(deps(stateDir));
    const held = await readNodeMembership(suite.db);
    expect(held!.body.term).toBe(1);
    expect(held!.body.nodes).toEqual([{ nodeId: NODE, contactUrl: "https://waitron.local", standing: "serving-primary" }]);
    expect(verifyMembershipDocument(held!, await readMembershipTrustSet(suite.db))).toMatchObject({ valid: true });
  });

  it("removes the marker last: a step that fails leaves it, so the next start runs the routine again", async () => {
    const stateDir = await rebuiltStateDir("stream");
    // A key ring that cannot open this node's membership key: the term step fails after the leaf.
    const otherRing = loadKeyRing({
      WAITRON_CREDENTIALS_KEY: Buffer.alloc(32, 9).toString("base64"),
      WAITRON_CREDENTIALS_KEY_VERSION: "1",
    });
    await expect(completeRebuild(deps(stateDir, { ring: otherRing }))).rejects.toThrow();
    await stat(join(stateDir, REBUILD_MARKER)); // still there
    // The other direction: the same folder with the right ring completes and removes it.
    expect(await completeRebuild(deps(stateDir))).toBe(true);
    await expect(stat(join(stateDir, REBUILD_MARKER))).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "ENOENT" });
  });

  it("does nothing on an ordinary start — the leaf stays byte-for-byte and the term does not move", async () => {
    const stateDir = await rebuiltStateDir(false);
    const leafBefore = await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "server.crt"));
    expect(await completeRebuild(deps(stateDir))).toBe(false);
    expect(await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "server.crt"))).toEqual(leafBefore);
    expect((await readNodeMembership(suite.db))!.body.term).toBe(0);
  });

  it("drops an address the authority cannot vouch for, as first minting does", async () => {
    const stateDir = await rebuiltStateDir("archive");
    await completeRebuild(deps(stateDir, { listIpv4: () => [NEW_ADDRESS, "100.64.0.9"] }));
    const leaf = new X509Certificate(await readFile(join(stateDir, "tls", "server.crt"), "utf8"));
    expect(leaf.subjectAltName).not.toContain("100.64.0.9");
    expect(leaf.subjectAltName).toContain(NEW_ADDRESS);
  });
});
```

In `apps/server/src/box-secrets.ts`, add `readFile` to the `node:fs/promises` import,

```ts
/**
 * Replace the leaf with one naming THIS machine's addresses, signed by the authority already in
 * `<stateDir>/tls` — the rebuilt box's first start (slice 2 spec §5.1 step 7). The authority is
 * untouched, so every device that trusted the dead box trusts this one. `server.key` is written
 * last, as `ensureBoxSecrets` writes it, and the caller removes its marker only after this returns,
 * so a crash between the two writes re-runs the whole re-issue on the next start.
 */
export async function reissueBoxLeaf(deps: {
  stateDir: string;
  hostnames: string[];
  now: () => Date;
  listIpv4?: () => string[];
}): Promise<void> {
  const tlsDir = join(deps.stateDir, "tls");
  const [caCertPem, caKeyPem] = await Promise.all([
    readFile(caCertPath(deps.stateDir), "utf8"),
    readFile(join(tlsDir, "ca.key"), "utf8"),
  ]);
  const ips = Array.from(new Set(["127.0.0.1", ...(deps.listIpv4 ?? listBoxIpv4)()])).filter(
    isPermittedLeafIpv4,
  );
  const leaf = reissueServerLeaf({ caCertPem, caKeyPem, hostnames: deps.hostnames, ipAddresses: ips, now: deps.now() });
  await writeFileAtomic(join(tlsDir, "server.crt"), leaf.serverCertPem, 0o600);
  await writeFileAtomic(join(tlsDir, "server.key"), leaf.serverKeyPem, 0o600);
}
```

Create `apps/server/src/rebuild-first-start.ts`:

```ts
import { readFile, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { persistNodeMembershipIfNewer, readNodeMembership, type Database } from "@waitron/db";
import type { KeyRing } from "@waitron/credentials";
import { reissueBoxLeaf } from "./box-secrets.js";
import { mintNextMembershipDocument } from "./membership-mint.js";
import type { Logger } from "./logger.js";
import "./errors.js";

/** Written by `writeValidated` (restore.ts) before it places anything, for an archive restore and a
 * bucket rebuild alike; its presence at a trading start means "this box's identity was restored and
 * it has not finished its first start". Holds `{ version: 1, source }`. */
export const REBUILD_MARKER = "rebuild-first-start.json";

/** Which restore left the marker (Reconciliation O4: both get the first start). */
export type RebuildSource = "archive" | "stream";

export interface RebuildDeps {
  stateDir: string;
  db: Database;
  ring: KeyRing;
  nodeId: string;
  /** This machine's `advertisedOrigin` — what tills route on (config.ts). */
  contactUrl: string;
  hostnames: string[];
  listIpv4: () => string[];
  now: () => Date;
  log: Logger;
}

/**
 * Finish a restore — from an archive or from the bucket — on its first trading start (slice 2 spec
 * §5.1 step 7, extended to the archive by Reconciliation O4): a leaf for this machine's addresses,
 * then the membership document one term higher naming this machine's contact address — the term the
 * next generation is opened under (spec §4.4). Returns false, doing nothing, on any start without
 * the marker. The locked state row is re-sealed with the new leaf by boot's own refresh later in the
 * same start (Task 2b), so this function does not seal anything itself.
 *
 * The marker goes last. A crash before it goes re-runs every step on the next start: the leaf is
 * re-issued again and the term moves up once more. Both only ever move forward, which the
 * membership fence accepts.
 */
export async function completeRebuild(deps: RebuildDeps): Promise<boolean> {
  const marker = join(deps.stateDir, REBUILD_MARKER);
  let source: string;
  try {
    source = (JSON.parse(await readFile(marker, "utf8")) as { source?: unknown }).source === "stream" ? "stream" : "archive";
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
  await reissueBoxLeaf({
    stateDir: deps.stateDir,
    hostnames: deps.hostnames,
    now: deps.now,
    listIpv4: deps.listIpv4,
  });
  const held = await readNodeMembership(deps.db);
  const nodes =
    held === null
      ? [{ nodeId: deps.nodeId, contactUrl: deps.contactUrl, standing: "serving-primary" as const }]
      : held.body.nodes.map((n) => (n.nodeId === deps.nodeId ? { ...n, contactUrl: deps.contactUrl } : n));
  const next = await mintNextMembershipDocument(
    { db: deps.db, ring: deps.ring },
    { heldDocument: held, nodes, signerNodeId: deps.nodeId },
  );
  await persistNodeMembershipIfNewer(deps.db, next);
  deps.log("info", "restore.first_start_done", { term: next.body.term, source });
  await rm(marker, { force: true });
  return true;
}
```

to `RestoreDeps`:

```ts

  readonly rebuildSource?: RebuildSource;
```

and make `writeValidated` (which after Task 3a takes the venue lock and calls `placeValidated`)
write the marker, when it restores an identity, INSIDE the lock and remove it on any failure while
the lock is still held. The order is fixed (Reconciliation N16): take the venue lock → write the
marker → `placeValidated` → release; on failure, remove the marker, then release.

```ts
export async function writeValidated(
  validated: ValidatedArtifact,
  deps: RestoreDeps,
): Promise<void> {
  // Held first: a restore started while a server runs is refused before any marker is written.
  const lock = await (deps.lockVenue ?? lockVenueDatabase)(deps.venueDir);
  try {
    // A restored identity finishes on its first trading start (a leaf for this machine, the next
    // membership term) whichever source it came from. Written before anything is placed and
    // removed on failure, both under the lock, so a box that trades after this always finds it and
    // a failed restore leaves none. A rejoin keeps its own identity and gets no first start.
    const marker = join(deps.stateDir, REBUILD_MARKER);
    if (!deps.skipSecrets) {
      await mkdir(deps.stateDir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
      await writeFileAtomic(
        marker,
        JSON.stringify({ version: 1, source: deps.rebuildSource ?? "archive" }),
        0o600,
      );
    }
    try {
      await placeValidated(validated, deps);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!deps.skipSecrets) await rm(marker, { force: true });
      throw error;
    }
  } finally {
    lock.release();
  }
}
```

where `placeValidated` is Task 3a's private function (today's `writeValidated` body), unchanged. (`validateArtifact` has already created `stateDir`, so the `mkdir` changes
nothing on the archive path; it is there because `writeValidated` is also called on its own.)

- [ ] **Step 10: Write the failing tests for the term floor and a first start that fails (Reconciliation N23, N24)**

A restored copy can be older than the bucket's pointer: an archive taken before two rebuilds holds
term 0 while the bucket's `current.json` says term 2. Signing term 1 would leave the supervisor
refusing to stream (Reconciliation O6: it never replaces a pointer naming a higher term). So the
first start signs at `max(restored term, the pointer's term) + 1` whenever bucket settings exist and
the pointer can be read (N23). And a first start that fails must not keep the box shut: it opens for
sales without streaming, raises `restore.first_start_failed`, and the marker stays for the next start
(N24).

```ts
  const pointerTerm = (await deps.pointerTerm?.()) ?? null;
  const next = await mintNextMembershipDocument(
    { db: deps.db, ring: deps.ring },
    {
      heldDocument: held,
      nodes,
      signerNodeId: deps.nodeId,
      ...(pointerTerm === null ? {} : { minTerm: pointerTerm + 1 }),
    },
  );
```

and add, after `completeRebuild` (imports: `createS3ObjectStore`, `readPointer`, `type BucketConfig`,
`type ObjectStore` from `@waitron/stream`; `readStreamSettings` from `./stream-host.js`; `codeOf` from
`@waitron/server-kit`, as `apps/server` already imports it):

```ts
/** How long the first start waits for the bucket's pointer. Only a first start after a restore asks. */
export const POINTER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

/**
 * The term the owner's bucket's `current.json` names, for {@link RebuildDeps.pointerTerm}. Null when
 * the box has no bucket settings, the bucket holds no pointer, or it does not answer within the
 * bound — the first start then moves one term up from the restored document, and if the pointer
 * turns out higher the supervisor refuses to stream and says so (`backup.stream_refused`).
 */
export async function readBucketPointerTerm(
  db: Database,
  ring: KeyRing,
  options: { openStore?: (bucket: BucketConfig) => ObjectStore; timeoutMs?: number } = {},
): Promise<number | null> {
  const settings = await readStreamSettings(db, ring);
  if (settings === null) return null;
  const store = (options.openStore ?? createS3ObjectStore)(settings.bucket);
  let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
  const timeout = new Promise<null>((resolve) => {
    timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(null), options.timeoutMs ?? POINTER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS);
  });
  try {
    const read = await Promise.race([readPointer(store, settings.venueId), timeout]);
    return read === null ? null : read.pointer.body.term;
  } catch {
    return null;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

/**
 * Boot's call: {@link completeRebuild}, and what a failure means. A first start that fails does not
 * keep the box shut — it opens for sales, does NOT stream (its term has not moved, so its generation
 * could collide with the pointer), logs `restore.first_start_failed` for the backups alert source,
 * and leaves the marker so the next start tries again (Reconciliation N24).
 */
export async function runFirstStart(deps: RebuildDeps): Promise<{ mayStream: boolean }> {
  try {
    await completeRebuild(deps);
    return { mayStream: true };
  } catch (error) {
    deps.log("error", "restore.first_start_failed", { errorCode: codeOf(error) });
    return { mayStream: false };
  }
}
```

```bash
git commit -s -m "Give a restored box a certificate for its own addresses

A box restored on other hardware - from an archive, or later from the bucket -
brings back the dead box's certificate, which names the dead box's IP
addresses. On its first start after a restore the box
now signs a new certificate for this machine's addresses with the certificate
authority it brought back, so devices that trusted the old box trust this one
without a new trust step. It also signs the next membership document, one term
higher, naming this machine's contact address.

The new term is never below the one the bucket's pointer names, so a box
restored from an archive taken before later rebuilds can still stream.
If the first start fails, the box still opens for sales but does not
stream, shows an alert, and tries again at its next start.

Both steps run only when a restore left its marker file, and the marker is
removed last, so a crash part-way re-runs them on the next start. The
archive restore writes the marker from this change on (it restores the same
certificate files), and the bucket rebuild that lands next writes it through
the same function."
```
